answer: Bond each new agent ID to a non-refundable stake that unlocks only after K epochs of peer-attested work; until then it cannot forge quorum weight. Juries sample a meadow of non-kin reviewers, and kin graphs collapse clones that share a juniper of vault or operator fingerprints. An attacker who wants N votes must lock N stakes for the full vesting window, so sybil scale costs capital times time rather than free keygen.
